reviews.x: Ordered this after watching Angie from Hot and Flashy evaluate products that get all your makeup off! Work from home and have washed my face/showered since last I wore makeup (don't typically unless leaving house). I typically wear a medium/light weight foundation for evening out skin tone (51 yr old), mascara, eyebrow pencil and only sometimes wear eye shadow. Got product, opened and used right at desk. Was very surprised to see that there was still (!!) makeup on the Wonder Cloth (also Hot and

I absolutely love this balm. I used oil cleansers followed by gel/foam cleansers for many years now. While I do not mind a liquidy cleanser, having it in solid form is so-so much better. I use mineral SPF and it's crucial to oil clean my face at night. The balm does a remarkable job. It also removes makeup (not sure about waterproof as I do not use it) great, including eye makeup without stinging my eyes. All and all, it's a winner. reviews.t: Beautiful jelly cleanser and makeup remover
reviews.x: Really enjoyed this for breaking up makeup and sunscrean. The packaging was very cute but I do prefer tubes, I think it keeps he air out. I did usually follow with a foaming gentle cleanser to remove any of this. It’s got a nice smooth jelly consistency and rosey scent. I found it non-drying and gentle. Really liked this, I would buy it again a but maybe as a gift for someone.

reviews.t: I love this balm as my first cleanser
reviews.x: I love this balm as my first cleanser. I tried Banila Clean it Zero previously and it broke me out. My skin is very sensitive and acne-prone, so I'm really glad my face loves this product! I love the slight herbally scent and it removes everything so well. The new flip cap is very convenient and makes access the product a lot easier than the old twist cap.

It seems that the new formulation is more difficult to rinse off. While I do second cleanse, this balm seems to leave an unpleasant film that takes a lot longer to rinse off. The need for a longer rinse/massage makes it less gentle on my skin than my experience with the older formulation.

This has been my go to cleansing balm for the last couple years but this most recent order the formula seems completely different. This has always been great at removing my makeup, been non irritating and easy to remove, but this last batch had been the opposite. It takes longer to remove my eye makeup , and once you add water to it it becomes glue-y and hard to wash off, it takes a few minutes to get it emulsified and then still feels like it leaves a film. It's also been irritating to my skin,

reviews.t: Wish I would’ve found this sooner!!
reviews.x: LOVE this product! Will buy over and over again! Smells amazing and removes my makeup without all the harsh scrubbing. It lasts forever. A little goes a long way. Make sure to put it on your dry face with dry hands however. I have combo/skin and this leaves my skin silky soft without feeling oily or dry. I use a very gentle cleanser right after this as part of my double cleanse routine and my face looks amazing. Adding this to my routine has really changed my skin.

This works like magic when used with a gentle hemp-washcloth.  This is so gentle to remove my makeup and I haven't found anything that works as well without me having to tug on my skin (just say noooo to wrinkles).  It has a lovely smell and I do a dual cleanse- so I'll wash with this first to remove my makeup and then use another gentle cleanser to do a secondary cleanse.  My face and skin quality is so much better now that I'm not using alcohol based products

reviews.t: Great cleansing balm. Alot of product.
reviews.x: This is one of my favorite cleansing balms next to the "clean it zero" by vanilla co. It has a pleasant scent and doesn't leave an oily residue after rinsing. I do always follow this up with a foam cleanser. The container holds alot of product so it lasts a long time. The tiny spatula is very hands to scoop out the product, I just keep it in the container and use it when needed. I've bought multiple of these and have gifted them to people.

reviews.t: WHOLE face of makeup? No problem!
reviews.x: This is my second time purchasing this facial cleanser, and it’s something I think I’ll always keep on hand. I have very sensitive skin (eczema/rosacea) and this does not irritate it at all. It does have a very mild scent, but it’s not unpleasant or overpowering. This leaves my skin clean and smooth rather than dry and tight, a HUGE plus for me when every other cleanser seems to strip my skin. If I could give it more stars, I 100% would.

reviews.t: I really like the new product packaging
reviews.x: I really like the new product packaging. It makes it easier to use when I can rest the inner lid in the snaptop outer lid. I've used this product for about a year and have gifted it to my sister in law. It takes off my sunscreen and makeup really well (better than the oily cleansers out there). When I first massage it in, my skin looks a little red, but that goes away once I rinse it off. Then my skin is really soft and clean.

I love that this takes off my makeup with little effort.  It's somewhat like a hardened cream.  I usually rub it between my fingers for a few seconds to get it to a liquid form and then massage all over my face.  It takes off eyeliner and mascara super easy.  I am able to do this step in my face washing routine in a couple of minutes so it makes my whole routine easier too!

reviews.t: Love it the first time but the consistency of my ...
reviews.x: This is the second time I bought this product. Love it the first time but the consistency of my second shipment is not thick as the fist one but watery. This product was kept in the same dry location as the shipment prior. If it was not for the consistency, it would get a better review.

The product I received is very watery, not a balm by any means. After reading other reviews, it seems I am not the first one to have this problem. Disappointing but at least it wasn't a lot of money to throw away.

Received it and the product was super liquidy with chunks. Not really what I was expecting for the price. And the holder for the spatula doesn’t fit in the lid and resulted in a lot of wasted product.

reviews.t: Cleanses without stripping the good stuff
reviews.x: One of my forever products. Cleans off all my makeup and doesn’t leave my skin stripped of all the good stuff. My only complaint is you can’t buy it in bigger quantities.
gave me cystic acne and that happens only once every 1,000 products so obviously there is something pore clogging in this formula
I’m on my third jar of this.. love the new packaging. A little goes a long way, melts into the skin and does not clog pores.
Great makeup remover that works perfectly the first time.  I have had no breakouts whatsoever.
I started to get red itchy bumps all over my face right after using it.

reviews.t: THIS IS ONE OF THE VERY BEST MAKEUP REMOVERS IVE EVER TRIED
reviews.x: This makeup remover is fantastic! has an awesome texture and removes even water resistant mascara and liquid eye liner. I usually use bifasics makeup removers from either lancome or garnier miscellar cleansing water all in 1, and this Balm has nothing to envy those cult favorites! It takes out every impurity, and doesn't leaves the face feeling oily, but it does leaves an awesome hydration and cleanliness feeling! Its easy to use, just a little amount removes everything, and you don't need to ru

I use Heimish All Clean Balm everyday to remove any makeup from my face. It is an excellent first step to double cleansing. I have been using it for over a year and it has never irritated my skin ( I have normal to dry skin). I find it very soothing and it removes any makeup or products I have on my face  wonderfully. Highly recommend if you are someone who double cleanse their face. My son, who has oily/acne prone skin also uses it and loves it!

This is my second tub I’ve ordered thru Amazon and it works great for me. Normally I order direct from another website and it takes longer to receive and a few dollars more.  The only problem I had was it wasn’t placed inside a plastic bag.  This item must have sat out somewhere warm that it was melting and the oil leaked out into the packaging.  Luckily it wasn’t too bad...or I just enjoy this product too much.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise how effectively it removes makeup and sunscreen, including eye makeup.
Many reviewers with sensitive or acne-prone skin report it is gentle and non-irritating.
The scent is commonly described as pleasant, mild, or medicinal/herbally.
Several reviewers like the new packaging, especially the flip cap and inner lid design.
A few reviewers report the newer formula or batch is harder to rinse off, leaves a film, or has a different consistency.
